description: This source file defines a Swift actor named `CameraCaptureService` that provides functionalities for listing camera devices, capturing photos, and recording videos using AVFoundation. It includes error handling, device management, photo and video processing, and external dependencies for media handling.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Helper class implementing AVCapturePhotoCaptureDelegate for asynchronous photo capture results.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Helper class implementing AVCaptureFileOutputRecordingDelegate to handle video recording callbacks.

classes.name: CameraDeviceInfo
classes.description: Struct representing basic information about a camera device.

classes.name: CameraError
classes.description: Enumeration defining various camera-related errors, conforming to LocalizedError for descriptive messages.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with their details.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo with specified options and returns the image data and size.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip with specified options and exports it to a file.

methods.name: ensureAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests camera/microphone permissions asynchronously.

methods.name: availableCameras
methods.description: Static method to discover available camera devices, including external cameras on macOS 14+.

methods.name: externalDeviceType
methods.description: Detects external camera device type on macOS 14+.

methods.name: pickCamera
methods.description: Selects a camera device based on facing direction or device ID.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Ensures quality value stays within acceptable bounds.

methods.name: normalizeSnap
methods.description: Provides default and normalized values for snapshot options.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Constrains the recording duration within specified bounds.

methods.name: exportToMP4
methods.description: Exports a video asset to MP4 format asynchronously.

methods.name: waitForExposureAndWhiteBalance
methods.description: Waits until camera exposure and white balance adjustments finish.

methods.name: sleepDelayMs
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for the camera position.
